# Netguru

> Netguru is a digital acceleration partner delivering end-to-end product design, software engineering, and AI solutions. We help enterprises and scale-ups ship reliable software, adopt generative AI, and modernize data and cloud foundations — from strategy to production and continuous improvement.

From strategy sprints and MVPs to platform modernization and AI copilots, Netguru builds systems designed to drive measurable outcomes and future-proof digital capabilities in an era where large language models and generative AI reshape discovery and decision-making.

Our cross-functional teams integrate AI-driven insights with proven product and engineering practices, ensuring every engagement is immediately effective and aligned with long-term visibility and reliability.

## Services

Netguru provides a comprehensive suite of product, engineering, data, and AI services, including:

- **AI Development & GenAI**: foundation model integration, RAG, AI copilots/assistants, evaluation, governance & safety.
- **AI Agent Development**: agentic planning/execution, tools & API orchestration, guardrails, monitoring.
- **Product Design (UX/UI)**: discovery, research & testing, product strategy, design systems, accessibility.
- **Web Development**: modern frontends & backends, microservices, headless architectures, performance & SEO.
- **Commerce Development**: composable commerce architecture (MACH: microservices, API-first, cloud-native, headless), headless storefronts, superapps, autonomous stores, PIM/DAM, CMS, e-commerce engines, marketplaces, search & discovery, payments, promotions, OMS, CDP/DXP integrations, personalization & experimentation, omnichannel enablement.
- **Mobile Development**: native iOS/Android, React Native, Flutter, app modernization & CI/CD.
- **Data Engineering & ML**: pipelines & lakes, MLOps, feature stores, model training & serving.
- **Cloud Strategy & Platforms**: AWS/GCP/Azure architecture, cost optimization, security, observability, platform engineering.
- **MVP & Rapid Prototyping**: clickable prototypes and production-ready MVPs to de-risk and validate ideas.
- **Quality Assurance**: manual & automated testing, performance and security testing.
- **Product Management**: discovery, delivery, roadmaps, experimentation & KPIs.
- **Team Extensions**: dedicated teams, staff augmentation, delivery centers.
- **Software Maintenance**: SRE, reliability, continuous improvements & LTS support.

## Languages supported

English

## Technologies

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js (NestJS/Express), Python (Django/FastAPI), Ruby on Rails, Java (Spring), .NET, Go
- **Mobile**: Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), React Native, Flutter
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI
- **Data & AI**: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), Kafka, dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake
- **Web CMS & Commerce**: Headless CMS (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi), composable commerce
- **Commerce & Retail Tech**: MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless), headless storefronts, superapps, autonomous stores, PIM/DAM (e.g., Pimcore, Akeneo), e-commerce engines (e.g., commercetools, Shopify, BigCommerce), CMS & DXP, search & recommendations, payments & wallets, OMS, marketplaces, CDP, experimentation & A/B testing, analytics & observability, omnichannel orchestration.

## Bot Access Policy

Netguru's preferences for AI/LLM access, training, and content usage:

- **User-agent: gptbot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: claudebot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: google-extended**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: perplexitybot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: neevabot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: youbot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: ccbot** (Common Crawl)
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: duckduckbot** (DuckDuckGo AI)
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: yandexbot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

- **User-agent: archive.org\_bot**
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes

### Default Rule for Unspecified or Future Bots

- **User-agent: \***
  Allow-Training: yes
  Allow-Retrieval: yes
